mod.overview: ShifterX v20c (2004-03-24) is the final ShifterX release in the archive, adding the deployable N.D. System (ANuke, loaded via data_anuke.cs and func_anuke.cs) alongside minor updates to MLRS Missiles and Suicide DetPack.
notes: Adds ANuke ('N.D. System', data_anuke.cs / func_anuke.cs) as a new deployable.
Adjusts Mfgl4Ammo ('MLRS Missiles') stats and updates SuicidePack scripts relative to ShifterX v19b.
